title: PlatformEvent
description: Typed event on Redis Stream `fl:events`. At-least-once delivery; consumers must be idempotent on event_id.

payload.description: Per type. verdict.*: {verdict, previous_verdict? (verdict.upgraded and re-checks), risk_score, input_type, registrable_domain, brand_id, fingerprints{dom_simhash, favicon_hash, script_embedding_id, asn, registrar, cert_issuer, registered_at}, top_signals[]}. report/feedback: {verdict_id?, kind, script_fingerprint? (script embedding cluster id, used by R3), signal? (used by R5)}. domain.observed: {domain_defanged, brand_candidates[], first_seen, source}. feed.updated: {feed, entries, age_s}.
